project.hardcoreEnglish.title: Hardcore English Conversation Trainer
project.hardcoreEnglish.subtitle: AI · Personal Project
project.hardcoreEnglish.problem: Improving spoken English requires practicing under real conversational pressure, but most language apps let you answer at your own pace, so they don't build real-time reflexes.
project.hardcoreEnglish.role: Designing the Next.js frontend and API Routes backend myself, and integrating the Claude API to build real-time conversation generation and a post-session correction report.
project.hardcoreEnglish.solution: Built a real-time conversation with a barista character (Claude Haiku) that requires a response within a 15-second limit, and separated the post-session correction report and feedback (Claude Sonnet) onto a heavier model to balance response speed with analysis quality.
project.jcb.title: JCB Cloud-Native Batch Platform Migration
project.jcb.subtitle: Finance Cloud Migration
project.jcb.problem: Maintaining the legacy JP1 batch system was creating growing operational burden and scalability constraints.
project.jcb.role: Reviewed the Cloud Run Jobs-based batch execution structure, designed wrapper shell scripts, execution parameter passing, and structured logging.
project.jcb.solution: Migrated JP1 batches to Cloud Run Jobs, containerizing with Docker, codifying infrastructure with Terraform, and building a GitLab CI/CD pipeline.
project.jcb.results: Documented the batch execution structure and operational automation framework, laying the groundwork for stable operations after migration.
project.awsPortfolio.title: Cloud Engineer Portfolio on AWS
project.awsPortfolio.subtitle: AWS Static Hosting
project.awsPortfolio.problem: Needed a way to reliably deploy a static portfolio site and collect visitor data.
project.awsPortfolio.role: Designed the S3/CloudFront deployment structure and built the visitor counter feature with Lambda and DynamoDB.
project.awsPortfolio.solution: Configured a custom domain and HTTPS with Route 53 and ACM, and automated S3 sync and CloudFront cache invalidation with GitHub Actions.
project.awsPortfolio.results: Automated the deployment pipeline into an operational structure that ships on every code push.
project.oracleOps.title: Oracle / Linux Operation Support
project.oracleOps.subtitle: RKKCS · National Health Insurance · Japan
project.oracleOps.problem: A Japanese health insurance system standardization project needed fast root-cause identification for system failures and output errors.
project.oracleOps.role: Handled operations and failure analysis for a Java and Oracle SQL-based system.
project.oracleOps.solution: Managed the operating environment through version setup, log analysis, and SQL verification, and analyzed the root causes of account, batch (job), and output errors.
project.oracleOps.results: Systematized root-cause analysis and response procedures, reducing response time for recurring issues.
project.gsifnWidget.title: KOSPI IR Stock Info Widget
project.gsifnWidget.subtitle: GSIFN · Financial Frontend · Live
project.gsifnWidget.problem: Major KOSPI-listed companies including Samsung, Hyundai, SK, POSCO, and Celltrion needed a reliable widget to display stock, financial, and disclosure data on their IR pages.
project.gsifnWidget.role: Owned the full lifecycle — planning, development, deployment, operations, and maintenance — of the iframe-embedded widget.
project.gsifnWidget.solution: Implemented the widget UI with HTML/CSS/JavaScript and managed the deployment and operating environment on Amazon EC2 via SSH.
project.gsifnWidget.results: Ran the widget reliably across five or more listed companies' IR sites, with ongoing maintenance.
